applies_to: slice 15, step 1: edit fixtures/units/roster/*.json at json_path, old to new, in this order (parents before the units that extend them)
json_path: units.<id>.<field>; mounts[id=X] is the mount whose id is X. Where `old` is absent the unit inherits the value (inherited_old) and the row adds the field to its own entry
digest: what each row changes in a battle: hull box, shell origin, eye or mobility
caps: every hull row is inside crates/contract/src/limits.rs:21-24 (tracked half-width 2.1 m, half-length 4.8 m)
